text:
[Council File 26-1400; CD 11]
Motion (Park - Blumenfield) relative to modifying Los Angeles Municipal Code Sections 53.42(a), 53.42(f), and 53.42(h) to explicitly prohibit the sale or purchase of animals on the Ocean Front Walk of Venice Beach; Department of Animal Services and Los Angeles Police Department staffing and resources to resume the Illegal Animal Sales Task Force; and, fabrication and installation costs for associated signage.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
summary: Motion to explicitly ban buying and selling animals on the Ocean Front Walk at Venice Beach, restart an illegal animal sales task force, and fund related signage.
